name: contact-sheet
description: Decode a short H.264 8-bit SDR clip into a labelled PNG contact sheet, selected PNG thumbnails and exact frame-index/source-PTS JSON in a ZIP. Choose 2–8 uniformly spaced frame indices or 1–8 explicit unique indices in your requested order, with 1–4 columns. Frames fit within 384x384 without enlargement. Limits: MP4/MOV up to 50 MB, 10 seconds, 2–600 frames, 1920px per side and 2.1 MP. Explicit non-square pixels are rejected; unspecified aspect uses a disclosed square default. No scene detection, semantic selection, audio or full-resolution export. Requires a connected account; exports are public.
